Merge

  • CURIE: gmeow:Merge
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Merge
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/software

The event of merging one branch of development into another — an activity with a merge-base commit, a source branch or ref, a target branch, and a resulting merge commit. The event type is gmeow:eventTypeMerge.

Structure

Subclass of: gmeow:Activity

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:Merge as a specialized kind of gmeow:Activity. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Activity
